description:
A price action trader needs to automate reversal signal detection on a SPY Daily chart. 

Your task is to:
1. Open a new Daily chart for SPY (S&P 500 ETF).
2. Add the 'CandleStickPattern' indicator to detect 'Doji' patterns. Configure this indicator to plot in 'Blue'.
3. Add a SECOND instance of the 'CandleStickPattern' indicator to the SAME chart to detect 'Hammer' patterns. Configure this indicator to plot in 'Magenta'.
4. Ensure both indicators are visible on the chart.
5. Save the workspace to persist your configuration.

Note: You must have two separate indicator instances running simultaneously. Do not just change the pattern on one indicator.
